content: Add a full-featured document editing engine to your ecosystem. Create an instance to connect storage-independent editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDFs — using <1>50+ ready-made connectors</1> for the platforms you already use, or connect to your own platform via API. You can connect one instance to multiple platforms.

comment.text: Promotional paragraph text on the DocsConnect page explaining the service's features and integration options. The <1> tag wraps a clickable link within the text.
